chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
If a person has a good idea about you, make his idea be true.

key_terms.صَدِّقْ: to verify, to make true, to confirm
key_terms.ظَنَّ: to suppose, to think, to have an opinion

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to validate others' good opinions of you according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises that one should act in a manner that validates the good opinion others have of them, a principle known as *siddq al-zann*. This ethical teaching encourages maintaining integrity and positive character to fulfill the expectations placed upon one by others, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *husn al-zann* (good opinion) as a social virtue that strengthens communal bonds and trust. By aligning one's actions with positive perceptions, individuals uphold the dignity of the community and demonstrate moral consistency.
